clauses.statement: applyDecisionOutcomeBinding must never leave stop_reason=decision_outcome_binding_failed or the decision_outcome_binding_failed reconciliation reason on a merge whose current binding status is not failed; the failure marker it sets on a failed pass must be removed by any later non-failed pass.
clauses.rationale: A transient first-pass binding failure must not become a permanent stop flag that idempotent successful reruns cannot clear.

clauses.statement: Given a merge object carrying reconciliation.reasons=[decision_outcome_binding_failed] and stop_reason=decision_outcome_binding_failed from a previous failed binding pass, when applyDecisionOutcomeBinding produces a bound or not_applicable binding, then the decision_outcome_binding_failed reason is removed, reconciliation.status becomes reconciled when no other reasons remain, and stop_reason becomes null; when other reasons remain, reconciliation.status stays reconciliation_required and stop_reason becomes delivery_reconciliation_required.

inherited_behavior.condition: a failed binding still sets reconciliation_required, appends decision_outcome_binding_failed, and sets stop_reason; stop_reason values set by other code paths are unchanged/existing

clauses.rationale: Reruns of the reconciliation path against a persisted pr-merge.json must be able to self-heal a stale failure flag without touching failure markers owned by other code paths.

clauses.rationale: The gate authorization denial branch is an existing scenario adjacent to the changed code; it is inherited, not modified.
